>
[Proud Mentor](/Feats.aspx?ID=5329) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 32

</column>

---

You enjoy mentoring others and take pride in your students' accomplishments. If you get a critical failure on an attempt to [Aid](/Actions.aspx?ID=2292), you get a failure instead. Whenever you successfully Aid an ally who critically succeeds on the check you Aided them on, you feel a rush of pride, gaining temporary Hit Points equal to your level, which last for 1 minute.
name: Proud Mentor
